1630.name: Max Honey
1630.effect: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also has the same effect as a Max Revive.

1631.name: Max Mushrooms
1631.effect: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

1632.name: Galarica Twig
1632.effect: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

1633.name: Galarica Cuff
1633.effect: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

1634.name: Style Card
1634.effect: A card that increases the selection in boutiques and hair salons.

1635.name: Armor Pass
1635.effect: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

1638.name: Exp. Charm
1638.effect: A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.

1639.name: Armorite Ore
1639.effect: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.

1640.name: Mark Charm
1640.effect: A mysterious and unique charm that increases the chance of finding a Pokémon with a mark.

1643.name: Galarica Wreath
1643.effect: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

1644.name: Legendary Clue 1
1644.effect: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

1645.name: Legendary Clue 2
1645.effect: A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written by Peony and has unique drawings.

1646.name: Legendary Clue 3
1646.effect: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written by Peony and has a unique drawing.

1647.name: Legendary Clue?
1647.effect: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped. There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole opening above the Max Lair.

1648.name: Crown Pass
1648.effect: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

1649.name: Wooden Crown
1649.effect: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

1650.name: Radiant Petal
1650.effect: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.

1651.name: White Mane Hair
1651.effect: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.

1652.name: Black Mane Hair
1652.effect: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.

1653.name: Iceroot Carrot
1653.effect: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

1654.name: Shaderoot Carrot
1654.effect: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

1655.name: Dynite Ore
1655.effect: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector in the Crown Tundra.

1656.name: Carrot Seeds
1656.effect: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

1657.name: Ability Patch
1657.effect: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

1658.name: Reins of Unity
1658.effect: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light. The people of old times presented these to the King of Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

2160.name: Linking Cord
2160.effect: Allows a Pokemon whose evolution is usually triggered by trading to evolve

2223.name: Heavy Ball (Legends: Arceus)
2223.effect: Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

2224.name: Leaden Ball
2224.effect: Upgraded version of the Heavy Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

2225.name: Gigaton Ball
2225.effect: Upgraded version of the Leaden Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

2226.name: Feather Ball
2226.effect: Can be thrown further than a regular Poké Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

2227.name: Wing Ball
2227.effect: Can be thrown further than a Feather Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

2228.name: Jet Ball
2228.effect: Can be thrown further than a Wing Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.
